summary.name: GarageBand for Mac
summary.one_liner: GarageBand is Apple's music creation studio app for the Mac, with built-in instruments, guitar and voice presets, and session drummers for recording, mixing, and sharing music.
use_cases: adding drum parts to a song
summary.what_it_does: GarageBand is a music creation studio built into the Mac. It includes a sound library of instruments, presets for guitar and voice, and a selection of session drummers and percussionists. The page describes it as a tool to learn, play, record, create, mix, and share music. The page presents it as an easy-to-use app with a modern design, aimed at beginners as well as people who want to make music professionally. Specific feature details and technical specs are not listed on the page.
notable: Built-in sound library with instruments, guitar and voice presets
Designed for beginners who have never played a note
caveats: Mac only; the page names macOS as the platform
Pricing is not stated on the page; the awesome-mac listing marks it as freeware
